name: graview.dev
description: Graview's own site and docs as a Graview app: every page graview.dev serves is a record, written out of the repository by scripts/site-docs.mjs and rendered by renderPlace, beside the packages, skills, checks and recipes it is about.

page.label: {title}
page.description: An address graview.dev serves: a web page, the Markdown twin beside it, or a file for crawlers and models.

path.description: Where it is served, from the site's root: index.html, docs/packages/core.html, llms.txt.

description.description: The one line it says about itself, to a search engine and in llms.txt.

design.description: Which of the site's designed pages writes it (apps/site/design.mjs).

format.description: What is served at its address.

twin.description: Where its Markdown twin is served, for a docs page.

rail.description: The docs rail's entry it stands under.

template.description: The hand-designed page it is filled into, under apps/site/pages/.

body.description: What it says, where that is a document in the repository rather than a design.

package.label: {name}
package.description: An npm package Graview ships, read off its package.json, its README.md and its barrel.

readme.label: README
readme.description: Its README.md, without the heading that repeats its name.

api.label: Exports
api.description: What its barrel, src/index.ts, exports by name.

dependsOn.inverse: the packages that depend on it

exports.inverse: the package it is an entry of

entry.label: {specifier}
entry.description: One subpath a package exports, as a product imports it.

subpath.description: The key in the package's exports: ./check.

skill.label: {name}
skill.description: An authoring skill an assistant reads before it changes a Graview app, read off its SKILL.md.

name.description: The name in its front matter.

description.description: What it teaches, from its front matter.

check.label: {code}
check.description: A thing graview check can say, read out of the checker's source.

command.label: graview {name}
command.description: A graview subcommand, read off the help the CLI prints.

usage.description: Its usage and its flags, as graview --help prints them.

blurb.description: What it does, as the help says it.

livesIn.description: the package whose concern it is

concept.label: {title}
concept.description: One of the ideas a Graview declaration is made of: not in the repository, the reason it is shaped the way it is.

says.description: The idea, in a few sentences.

position.description: Where it comes on the concepts page.

recipe.label: {title}
recipe.description: The prompt on the front page with a different task, and the declaration and seed an agent made of it, under docs/site/recipes/.

title.description: What the front page calls it.

prompt.description: The prompt, with the task in it.

blurb.description: What the app it made keeps track of.

name.description: The name its declaration gives the app.

summary.description: The description its declaration gives the app.

document.label: app.json
document.description: Its declaration, as the agent wrote it.

counts.description: How many records of each kind its seed holds: kind=count.

records.description: How many records its seed holds.

relations.description: How many relations its seed holds.

check.description: What graview check --document says about its declaration, line by line.

chapter.label: {number}. {title}
chapter.description: A step of the garden, grown: a declaration that passes its own check, opened in a browser on every push.

example.label: apps/{dir}
example.description: An example app in the repository, described by its own package.json.

question.label: {question}
question.description: A question the front page answers plainly, read off its FAQ.

answer.description: The answer, as the front page gives it.

position.description: Where it comes in the FAQ.

release.label: {version}
release.description: A version every package shares, read off @graview/core's changelog and the CLI's package.json.

changes.description: How many changes @graview/core's changelog lists under it.

current.description: The version the packages are at now.

scaffold.label: {name}
scaffold.description: What graview create writes, read from the generator itself.

scripts.description: The scripts it gives a project: name = command.

add-entry.title: Add an entry point
add-entry.description: Record a subpath a package exports.

add-check.title: Add a check finding
add-check.description: Record a thing graview check can say.

add-concept.title: Add a concept
add-concept.description: Record an idea a declaration is made of.

add-recipe.title: Add a recipe
add-recipe.description: Record a prompt and what an agent made of it.

add-chapter.title: Add a chapter
add-chapter.description: Record a step of the garden, grown.

add-example.title: Add an example app
add-example.description: Record an example app in the repository.

add-question.title: Add a question
add-question.description: Record a question the front page answers.

add-release.title: Add a release
add-release.description: Record a version every package shares.

point-page-at.title: Say what it is about
point-page-at.description: Name the record this page is about.

unpoint-page.title: Take back what it is about
unpoint-page.description: Say this page is no longer about that record.

file-page-under.title: File it under a page
file-page-under.description: Name the page it sits under.

unfile-page.title: Take it out from under
unfile-page.description: Say it no longer sits under that page.
unfile-page.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a page out from under it

depend-on.title: Depend on a package
depend-on.description: Name a package it depends on.
depend-on.fromTheOtherEnd: Have a package depend on it

stop-depending.title: Stop depending on a package
stop-depending.description: Say it no longer depends on that package.
stop-depending.fromTheOtherEnd: Have a package stop depending on it

export-entry.title: Export an entry point
export-entry.description: Name an entry point it exports.

unexport-entry.title: Stop exporting an entry point
unexport-entry.description: Say it no longer exports that entry point.

house-command.title: Say which package answers it
house-command.description: Name the package whose concern it is.

unhouse-command.title: Take it out of its package
unhouse-command.description: Say that package no longer answers it.
unhouse-command.fromTheOtherEnd: Take a command out of it

teach-concept.title: Say which skill teaches it
teach-concept.description: Name the skill that teaches this idea.

unteach-concept.title: Take back which skill teaches it
unteach-concept.description: Say that skill no longer teaches this idea.
